name: step-progress
title: Step Progress
description: One progress bar cut into a segment per step with labels underneath. Finished steps are full, the current one fills as far as you say.

props.name: current
props.description: Zero-based current step. Pass steps.length when everything is done.

props.name: partial
props.description: How far through the current step you are, 0 to 1.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the progress bar.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
